regions.name: The middle Mississippi and lower Ohio
regions.basis: The American Bottom around Cahokia and the valleys either side of the Mississippi-Ohio confluence. The bounding longitudes follow the Mississippi's own course as traced from OpenStreetMap, which runs through 90.2W at the latitude of Cahokia. A box, and much smaller than the Mississippian world the archaeology article describes across the Southern United States and the Eastern Woodlands: it is the core, not the extent.
